message:
How it reads now:
Leads sheet
Company (text, required), Contact (text), Email (email), Source (Referral, Inbound, Outbound or Event), Expected value a year (money), Owner (person, whoever adds it), Next follow-up (date), Notes (long text).

Companies sheet
Name (text, required), Website (url).

Steps
New → Contacted → Qualified → Proposal → Won or Lost

Who can see and do what
Wade Wilson and Dev Kumar see every lead, add, edit and move them, and change how it works.
Lead owners see their own leads and can add, edit and move them.
Everyone else sees nothing.

Connections
People fills Owner.

Later
A Contacts sheet for several people at one company
A reminder to the owner when a follow-up date arrives

Coming soon
Connections to other software

The chat so far:
Admin: Add a Companies sheet
Bike: (sent a preview)
Admin: Add a Companies sheet with just a name and a website. No owner.
Bike: (sent a preview)
Admin: Apply
Bike: Applying the change to Sales leads. This takes a few seconds.

Latest message:
Why can't lead owners see companies?
